examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Default card with a title header and body content in the `content` slot.

examples.name: Header
examples.summary: An action rendered through the `header` slot stays visible, aligned to the end of the header.

examples.name: Footer
examples.summary: Filling the `footer` slot renders the footer bar with actions or metadata.

examples.name: Flush
examples.summary: Set `padded=false` for edge-to-edge content such as an ItemList with full-width dividers.

examples.name: Integration
examples.summary: `kind="integration"` builds a catalog tile from the logo, the name, the vendor, a short description and a badge; the whole tile opens the detail through `select`, and the Install action in the `action` slot stays its own target.

examples.name: Installed
examples.summary: An installed integration shows the Installed tag and swaps Install for Configure; with `href` the tile is a link to the integration's page.
